answer: Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 87 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. The horizon schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the copper checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Someone wanting 131 effective identities must lock that capital for 87 epochs and keep it locked through every knoll audit. That is 35 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
